name: Pack the Polyominoes (Reflections Allowed)
description: Pack a set of 100–10,000 polyominoes (each 1–10 cells) into an axis-aligned rectangle using rotations, reflections, and translations with no overlaps, minimizing the rectangle area A = W × H. Scored 0–1 by area ratio against the reference packing across 140 hidden cases. Time limit 2s, memory 256 MB.
